name: Instruct Particulate
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: This repository contains a self-contained Gradio demo for the FINAL-ours-final2026-05-01T12-36-12 Instruct Particulate checkpoint. On Hugging Face Spaces, the large model checkpoint is downloaded at startup from rayli/instruct-particulate-model. Runtime outputs are written under /data when that mount is available, so the Space can use the rayli/instruct-particulate-results read/write bucket. Local runs fall back to ./data. Set INSTRUCTPARTICULATEOUTPUTROOT to override that location.
The app accepts one .glb or .obj mesh and a kinematic tree JSON. Link IDs must be dense integers starting at 0; joints use revolute or prismatic.
